1

What Is Technographic Data?

Technographic data provides information about the technologies a company uses, such as software applications, cloud platforms, customer relationship management systems, marketing tools, cybersecurity solutions, and other business technologies.

These insights can help sales and marketing teams understand a company's technology environment and identify potential opportunities that align with their products or services.

💡

For example, a software provider selling marketing automation solutions may use technology insights to identify businesses that use related platforms or may benefit from a different solution.

When combined with relevant company and contact information, technographic insights can support more informed prospect selection and personalized sales outreach.

2

Why Is Technographic Data Important?

Understanding the technology landscape of potential customers can help businesses move beyond broad prospect lists and focus on accounts that are more relevant to their offerings.

Identify Better-Fit Prospects

Use technology adoption insights to help identify companies whose existing technology environment aligns with your product or service.

Personalize Sales Outreach

Develop more relevant conversations based on a prospect's potential technology needs, existing systems, and business priorities.

Support Account-Based Marketing

Use technology-related insights alongside company and decision-maker information to support account research and targeted campaigns.

Discover Potential Sales Opportunities

Technology changes, new implementations, and evolving business requirements can indicate opportunities for relevant solutions. Technographic data can help inform research into these opportunities, although it does not guarantee buying intent.

Improve Prospect Prioritization

Combine technology insights with firmographic information and other qualification criteria to help your team prioritize accounts more effectively.

3

What Information Can Technographic Data Include?

Depending on data availability and coverage, technographic datasets may include:

🧩

Software and applications

Business software, CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, and other applications.

☁️

Cloud and infrastructure technologies

Cloud platforms, hosting technologies, and relevant infrastructure tools.

🔒

Security technologies

Cybersecurity products and related technology categories.

🛒

E-commerce platforms

Online store platforms and supporting business technologies.

📶

Technology adoption indicators

Available signals about the technologies a company uses or has implemented.

🏢

Company information

Business name, industry, company size, and website, where available.

👤

Contact information

Relevant business contacts and professional details, where available.

ℹ️

The exact fields depend on the dataset, technology coverage, and verification process. Technology usage should be treated as an informed data point, not proof that a company is currently purchasing a solution.

4

6

Technographic Data vs. Firmographic Data

Technographic and firmographic data provide different types of company insights. Used together, they can help build a more complete picture of a potential account.

Data TypeWhat It Tells YouExample
Technographic dataTechnologies a company usesCRM, cloud platform, marketing software
Firmographic dataCharacteristics of a companyIndustry, company size, location
Contact dataInformation about business professionalsJob title, business email, department
Intent dataAvailable indicators of potential research or buying interestTopic research or relevant purchase-intent signals

Combining these data types can support account selection and qualification. Explore our Intent Data Solutions and Data Enrichment Services for related prospecting capabilities.
